properties.name: krizaka.users.client.base-url
properties.description: Base URL of the users service, e.g. 'http://localhost:8083'. Setting it switches the client on.

properties.name: krizaka.users.client.cache-ttl
properties.description: How long a user, profile or tier is reused before it is fetched again.

properties.name: krizaka.users.client.service-key
properties.description: This caller's own P-256 private key (PKCS#8 PEM, from its environment, never committed): the SERVICE token of every call is signed ES256 with it (ADR-001), and the users service holds only the public half. Preferred.

properties.name: krizaka.users.client.service-key-id
properties.description: The kid of serviceKey. Required with it.

properties.name: krizaka.users.client.service-name
properties.description: Who is calling: the subject of the SERVICE token, visible in the users service's logs. Required.

properties.name: krizaka.users.client.service-secret
properties.description: Legacy shared HS256 secret, accepted only until the users service's dated cutover. Exactly one of serviceKey and serviceSecret is required.
